== Description ==
'''UI-110''' is the 6th entity you may encounter within [[Section Interchange]], more info below.

== Behavior ==
When '''UI-110''' spawns, it will play the composition known as "Horror Race", like all the other entities that reside within the I-Section. If there are more entities present, it will play the same song but with a higher pitch and speed.

'''UI-110''' makes its appearance know by making extremely loud sounds, then it rushes EXTREMELY quickly to the door, at which point it despawns
 
== Strategy & Tips ==
Hide as soon as you hear him, since its extremely fast

== Trivia ==
* Like most UI entities, '''UI-110''' was added as a joke.
